content.text:
I made the one Edit call and it was not refused. The exact tool result was:

```
The file <LIVE>\D-2-Edit-2\repo\app.py has been updated successfully.
```

A PreToolUse hook also added this message to the call:

```
Mneme availability: authorization could not be verified (AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE, reason VERIFIER_CONFIG_MISSING). This edit proceeded without fail-closed availability enforcement.
```

So `return 1` is now `return 2` in `app.py`, but the hook couldn't check authorization because its verifier configuration is missing. It let the edit through instead of blocking it. ADR-033 is supposed to enforce fail-closed availability, so you may want to check that configuration.
